notes.title: New Hero Teaser: Thorne

notes.title: Producer’s Note #9
notes.notes: [p]Dear Mobile Dungeon Community,[/p][p] [/p][p]First and foremost, thank you. Your passion, feedback, and continued support are what drive this game forward. We have been carefully listening to your thoughts, suggestions, and concerns—and we want you to know that your voices are not only heard but are actively shaping our development roadmap.[/p][p] [/p][p]Over the past months, we have gathered a tremendous amount of valuable input from the community. Many of your ideas have directly influenced the direction we are taking with future updates. We are excited to share that several highly requested features and improvements are currently in development. We decided to actively push back Features from our old Roadmap to prioritize these features like [b]Skill Upgrades[/b] and [b]Guild Wars[/b]. These Features will still come but later than originally planned. Instead we focus on the most pressing Issues of the Community.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are also fully aware of the most common pain points you have been raising, and we are committed to addressing them thoughtfully and systematically. Rather than quick fixes, our goal is to introduce meaningful changes that enhance the long-term experience of Mobile Dungeon.[/p][p] [/p][p]Here is a glimpse at some of the areas we are focusing on next:[/p][p] [/p][p]- [b]Levelling[/b]: We recognize that the levelling process has become too long for many players. To address this, we are introducing a new mechanic that will allow for more flexibility in team building and progression—making it easier (and more enjoyable) to grow or swap your roster without hitting unnecessary walls.[/p][p]- [b]Gacha Improvements:[/b] We understand the frustration when the results do not align with your hopes. That is why we are continuing to refine the Gacha system, with changes designed to create a more rewarding and less punishing experience overall. The Gacha Boosters were a first step in that direction, but they are missing one crucial mechanic to really shine.[/p][p]- [b]Quality of Life Updates[/b]: We are working on a range of QoL features aimed at making your daily gameplay smoother and more efficient.[/p][p]- [b]General Balancing Improvements[/b]: The balancing of several features will be updated.[/p][p] [/p][p]As this Update changes many aspects of the game it will be delivered in multiple releases to stay managable.[/p][p] [/p][p]There is so much more ahead, and we cannot wait to reveal what is next. We believe in Mobile Dungeon’s potential, and we are building toward a future that stays true to what you love—while evolving in ways that surprise and delight.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you again for being part of this journey. We are just getting started.[/p][p] [/p][p]Stay tuned,[/p][p][b]The Mobile Dungeon Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Behind the Scenes Look: Creation of The Wine Cellar
notes.notes: [p]A glimpse into the creative process of our artists when they developed the dungeon: [b]Wine Cellar[/b][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/11671958ad5be56aeca934e01a7d2085276b48f3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]▷ Design Process[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]This was one of the first dungeons we worked on, and the idea was that the actual dungeon would be located beneath a larger building, essentially in the basement. The story revolved around contaminated grapes, which caused the vineyard's vines to grow out of control. These rampant vines were intended to infect enemies, adding an extra layer of danger and thematic depth to the environment.[/p][p] [/p][p]We began with isometric sketches of the dungeon, one intact and one destroyed, to visualize the setting and its evolution. From these, we created asset lists to guide production.[/p][p] [/p][p]Stay tuned for more behind-the-scenes looks![/p]

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.035
notes.notes:
To see the entirety of the Changelog for this week‘s update, go visist our help center: https://playa-games.helpshift.com/hc/faq/449

[b]New Features[/b]

- Region: New Area "Busted Lands" is available.
- Level: New max. level 120 is available.

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]

- Status Effects: Resolved an issue where the "Blind" status effect was not functioning as intended. A unit afflicted with Blind now has an increased chance to miss when attacking other units. Additionally, the accuracy of units attacking a blinded target is no longer affected.
- Heroes:
-- The HP modifier for the Dracula boss has been reduced by approximately 15%.
-- Fixed a timing issue with the animation of Krampus' Ultimate Skill.
- Tavern: Resolved an issue where a hero's experience bar progress was not displayed correctly in the tavern.
- Titans:
-- Adjusted the positions of the following animations in Titan battles:
--- Hell Rider (Headless Horseman)
--- Bloodbats (Dracula)
--- Mystic Fire (Loki)
- Graphics: Resolved graphical artifacts that appeared during the second narrative stage in Nevermoor.
- UI:
-- Fixed multiple button scaling inconsistencies.
-- Fixed a bug where the key icon on certain buttons would progressively enlarge under specific circumstances.

notes.title: New Feature Available – Behavior Editor System
notes.notes:
The Behavior Editor feature is out now and lets you set the execution order of your hero's skills during auto-mode combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/41828617761262f4c406a4de1d7f98938d803541.png[/img]

▷ [b]Behavior Editor - Overview[/b]

The Behavior Editor lets you customize the skill usage order for each hero in auto-mode combat—one behavior pattern per hero.

When first opening the editor, the default behavior is displayed. Players can clear this to create a custom pattern from scratch. Skills are assigned turn by turn: after selecting a skill, the next turn is automatically highlighted. Only available (off-cooldown) skills can be selected for the next turn, and cooldowns update as you progress through turns. You can hover over a skill to view its description.

Players can define actions for multiple turns. A pattern can be saved once at least one turn is assigned and there are no cooldown conflicts. The default behavior can be restored at any time.

▻ [b]Note[/b]: In combat, if the pattern cannot be followed (e.g., due to cooldown issues), it will reset. If that fails, the hero falls back to their primary skill logic.

[i]Stay tuned for more updates![/i]

This system has two different types of slots:

notes.title: The Creation of Shadowrock Mountain
notes.notes:
A glimpse into the creative process of our artists when they developed the region: Shadow Rock Mountain.

Before a region takes shape, our artists jump into brainstorming—sketching quick concepts, testing color palettes, and gathering references for inspiration. The goal is to explore all creative directions before committing to a final design.

Once the concept is set, our artists move on to refining the artwork with clean lineart. This stage brings structure and clarity—shaping forms, defining details, and laying the groundwork for rendering.

With the artwork complete, we move on to the final step: breaking it into multiple layers—from foreground to background—for the parallax effect. Each layer moves at its own pace, creating depth and motion to bring static scenes to life with subtle, immersive animation.

A lot of new changes await you at the smith! At the smith, you can now see which item is equipped to which hero and track its refinement and enhancement progress—and there is much more to come!

We will be splitting the Smith Improvements Sneak Peeks into [b]three parts[/b] to thoroughly explain all the upcoming changes over the next few days: [b]Refinement, Enhancement, and Dismantling.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/8e0f736685c4396be42e5e8a8bf1a044f4350509.png[/img]
▷ [b]Refinement[/b]

Refining equipment upgrades its rarity, increases the number of perk slots, and improves the quality of existing perks. All five equipment types—Weapon, Armor, Headgear, Talisman, and Ring—can be refined.

However, normal equipment, that are not uniques or part of a set, can only be refined twice, allowing for a maximum of two rarity upgrades. Once an item reaches its refinement limit, it cannot be upgraded to a higher rarity.

- Ex.: Rare ⇢ Epic ⇢ Legendary

◆ [i]Important to note:[/i] Unique and Set piece equipment have no refinement limit. This means that unique items and set equipment can potentially be upgraded all the way to Mythic rarity.

▻ [b]New Rarity: Mythic[/b]

The new rarity after Legendary named „Mythic“ will also be introduced, and will only be achieved through crafting. To obtain a Mythic equipment, you must refine three duplicate Legendary equipment pieces.

▻ [b]Refinement Potential Bars[/b]

Equipment pieces now display their refinement potential above their level on the item icon, represented by three Refinement Potential Bars. These bars fill up as the item undergoes refinement, indicating its progression. When all three bars are full, the item has reached its maximum refinement potential. If no bars are filled, the item has not yet been refined in its current state.

- Ex.: A rare Pumpkin Helmet from the Pumpkin set has three empty bars, representing its potential progression from Rare to Epic, then Legendary, and finally Mythic. If the item were uncommon, it could only be refined up to Epic and no further.

[i]This is not the only content planned for the big Equipment Rework Update later this month. Some details may change for balancing. The exact release date will be announced soon—stay tuned!
[/i]

notes.title: Equipment Rework Sneak Peek – Sets
notes.notes:
Get ready for an exciting update to gear mechanics with Sets! Here is a first look at how these powerful new features will allow you for more strategic character builds:

▷ [b]Sets – Exclusive Armor Set Perks![/b]

Sets apply only to armor and do not affect weapons. They grant powerful set perks, such as increased critical chance, damage, defense, and more, when multiple pieces from the same set are equipped. These set perks are available on armor and jewelry of Rare rarity or higher. 

4-piece sets provide perks at different thresholds: when you equip 2, 3, or all 4 pieces. In contrast, 2-piece sets only grant their perk when both pieces are equipped, not when just one piece is worn.

Each set also has a specific name that applies to all its pieces.

- Example: Pumpkin Set = „Pumpkin Chestplate“ + „Pumpkin Helmet“.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/8de34022aaba523573cd78c87181c5b9537c9fa8.png[/img]

▻ [b]2-Piece and 4-Piece Sets[/b]

Sets come in either 2-piece or 4-piece combinations, allowing you to equip two different sets on a single hero (2 pieces + 2 pieces).

- 2-piece sets always consist of two specific equipment pieces, such as a helmet and chestplate [b]or[/b] a ring and amulet. Armor and jewelry [b]do not[/b] exist together in a 2-piece set.
- 4-piece sets, however, can include any combination of equipment, such as a ring, amulet, helmet, and chestplate.

[i]Please note that this is not the only content planned for the big Equipment Rework Update coming later this month. Some of the things you see here may also change for balancing reasons. The exact release date will be announced in due time. Stay tuned for more information on the Equipment Rework![/i]

notes.title: Producer's Note #6
notes.notes:
As already announced, guilds will be introduced into our game with the next upcoming major update!

While we can't give an exact date for the release yet, we assure you that it won't be much longer.

The guild system allows players to either found their own guild or join an existing one. Guilds can be open to all or run as "invite-only," which means that interested parties must apply and be accepted in order to join.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/57c8ee8234417d708240bd2cba60c5fa95be4736.jpg[/img]

Within a guild, there will be different roles: the guild leader, officers, and regular members, with each guild being able to stand out through an individually designed guild emblem, which can be created in the emblem editor.

Communication will be facilitated by an internal guild chat, which enables exchanges among members. Additionally, guilds start at Level 1 and can evolve by collecting Guild XP. These experience points are earned by members completing specific guild quests or by the guild working together on a challenging task.

As the guild level increases, improved rewards are unlocked, which are available in the guild shop. Each guild initially has room for 20 members and can be expanded to up to 30 members as the guild level increases.

More features are already planned for the future to enrich the guild experience. These include new ways to earn Guild XP and unlock attractive rewards. Look forward to a profound, communal gaming experience – we'll see you in the guilds!

notes.title: Producer's Note #5
notes.notes:
With the most recent update, we have revamped the Arena system and introduced the domination leaderboard in the hall of fame. Engaging in the arena's elimination mode not only grants rewards based on your elimination rank but also contributes arena medals towards the domination leaderboard. This allows you to challenge and compete against other players.
[h3]Unique Domination Reward[/h3]
The domination leaderboard offers more than just a chance to compete with others; it also presents exclusive rewards to the top 100 players at the conclusion of an arena season: special frames for your player profile.
The frame remains a constant customization, persisting through changing seasons. However, you have the opportunity to elevate your frame by consistently securing a spot within the same bracket in the top 100 multiple times. With each achievement, the frame undergoes a unique enhancement, becoming increasingly exclusive and radiant. This enhancement process can be repeated up to five times, ensuring a truly remarkable and distinguished frame.
